say:2:1641122101:1.text: Glug glug... Aaah! This magic icy drink is bursting with fizzy bubbles! It's like tiny fireworks are popping in Chippy's stomach!
say:2:1641122101:1.source_cn: 咕噜噜……好凉好甜！这杯魔法冰饮里有好多小气泡，喝下去...

say:4:1641122103:1.text: ... Wait. Did you just finish the whole jug? That was meant for a group!
say:4:1641122103:1.source_cn: ……你都喝光了？那可是一整壶的份量吧？

say:5:1641122104:1.text: Chippy couldn't help it! The bubbles were escaping. If Chippy didn't drink it, they'd be wasted!
say:5:1641122104:1.source_cn: 没办法嘛，它自己在冒泡泡，我不喝完泡泡就会跑掉的！

say:6:1641122105:1.text: Are you sure you're okay...? Your stomach looks twice as round as before.
say:6:1641122105:1.source_cn: 真的没事吗……你的肚子都鼓起来了，比之前还要圆。

say:7:1641122106:1.text: Ughhh... Chippy can't move... It feels like Chippy just swallowed a water balloon.
say:7:1641122106:1.source_cn: 呜哇，真的走不动了……肚子好沉。

say:8:1641122107:1.text: Magister... help... Chippy has gone full puffball. You'll have to roll Chippy home...
say:8:1641122107:1.source_cn: 主人，我站不起来了……你们拉我一把吧……
say:8:1641122107:1.male: Magister... help... Chippy has gone full puffball. You'll have to roll Chippy home...
say:8:1641122107:1.female: Magister... help... Chippy has gone full puffball. You'll have to roll Chippy home...
